title: Back-Rank Checkmate
description: Black's king is trapped behind their own pawns. Deliver the decisive back-rank checkmate in one move!

title: Decisive Overload
description: Black has one rook guarding the back rank. Overload the defender with an aggressive Queen sacrifice to deliver mate!

title: The Royal Knight Fork
description: White's knight has a devastating fork square that attacks both the black king and undefended rook on c8.

title: Absolute Rook Skewer
description: Check Black's exposed king along the open e-file to force it away and win the stranded rook behind it!

title: Morphy's Opera Deflection
description: Inspired by Paul Morphy's 1858 Opera game: Queen sacrifice deflecting the knight to deliver back-rank mate with the rook!

title: Boden's Mate Theme
description: Sacrifice the Queen on c6 to shatter the pawn shield and deliver checkmate with criss-crossing bishops!

title: Philidor's Smothered Mate
description: Deliver a queen sacrifice check on g8 that forces the rook to smother its own king, setting up the knight checkmate!

title: Anastasia's Mate
description: The knight on e7 clamps down on the escape squares. Sacrifice the Queen on h7 to open the file for a lethal rook mate!
